authority_anchor: On 21 December 2023, the Security Council unanimously adopted Resolution 2719 at meeting S/PV.9518 on financing for African Union-led peace support operations.
The Council agreed to consider requests from the African Union Peace and Security Council case by case. Authorized operations would remain under African Union command and control.

For operations authorized by the Council, UN assessed contributions may cover up to 75 percent of the annual operation budget. The UN and African Union are to jointly mobilize the remainder as extrabudgetary resources. The Council committed to consider viable options if significant shortfalls arise.

authority_anchor: On 10 January 2020 the Security Council adopted the Belgium–Germany draft S/2020/24 as Resolution 2504 by 11 votes to none. China, Russia, the United Kingdom and United States abstained.

The Council renewed the cross-border humanitarian and monitoring arrangements under paragraphs 2 and 3 of Resolution 2165 for six months, through 10 July 2020. Bab al-Salam and Bab al-Hawa remained authorized. Al-Ramtha and Al Yarubiyah were excluded.
